title: Keto Dutch Potato Casserole
description: A delicious and comforting keto casserole that combines the best of Dutch potato recipes with nutritious ingredients.
instructions: Boil the Dutch potatoes until tender. Drain and set aside.
Cook the nourishing bacon in a pan until crispy. Set aside.
In a separate pan, melt the butter or ghee over medium heat.
Add the casserole seasoning and stir for 1 minute.
Combine the cooked potatoes, crispy bacon, and gooey cheese with the casserole seasoning mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
